title: Sign in to PaperWrench
description: Sign in with your Paperless API token or your local PaperWrench account.
storage: Without memorization, the token stays only in server memory until logout, expiry or restart. PaperWrench never saves it in browser storage.
rememberHelp: Your username comes from Paperless automatically. Choose a local password of at least 12 characters. The server stores your token encrypted so you can sign in again after a restart.
recovery: Forgotten password or revoked token? Choose “Use a token” and supply a valid Paperless token to replace your saved credentials.
isRemembered: Your Paperless token is remembered on this server.
replaceHelp: Enter a valid token for this same Paperless account and a local password of at least 12 characters. Other sessions will be signed out.
deleteHelp: Removes the saved token and local password and signs out all your sessions. Your PaperWrench data is kept.
